subject: Students and Mentors: Midterms are Approaching!

messages.subject: Students and Mentors: Midterms are Approaching!
parts:
I thought I would take a moment to remind everyone that the midterm
evaluation period is starting on July 9th and provide a little guidance.

Students:
How are you doing on your project plan?
If the project plan needs revising, are you communicating regularly with
your mentor to adjust expectations?
If you are not in regular communication with your mentors, please
contact me or one of the R project admins, below, as soon as possible.

Mentors:
Keep an eye out on the Google Mentors list for instructions from Carol.
The *primary mentor* for each project will need to fill out an
evaluation in melange. As of right now I don't see any way to assign
additional mentors to a project, and it's not clear if all R project
mentors will be able to fill out evaluations.

If anyone has questions or problems, please don't hesitate to contact me
or one of the other R GSoC admins (John Nash, Virgilio Gomez, Toby
Hocking) as soon as possible so that we can work with you to resolve
it.

Regards,

- Brian
